SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(invoice) FROM bc_job_ledger_entry_month
    WHERE company_name = $1 AND year = $2::int
      AND concepto_analitico_descripcion = 'Ingresos'), 0) AS r_sum,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(invoice) FROM bc_job_planning_line
    WHERE company_name = $1 AND year = $2::int
      AND status IN ('Planning','Quote','Open','Completed','Lost')
      AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PP%' AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PY%'
      AND (
        COALESCE(budget_date_year, 0) = 0
        OR (budget_date_year = year AND month >= budget_date_month)
      )), 0) AS p_planif_sum,
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bc_meses_cerrados
    WHERE company_name = $1
      AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PP%' AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PY%'), 0) AS cerrados_count,
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bc_job_planning_line
    WHERE company_name = $1 AND year = $2::int
      AND budget_date_year = 0 AND COALESCE(invoice,0) <> 0
      AND status IN ('Open','Planning')
      AND make_date(year, month, 1) < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)), 0) AS budget0_past_count,
  (SELECT MAX(last_sync_at) FROM sync_state
    WHERE company_name = $1
      AND entity IN ('bc_job_planning_line','bc_job_ledger_entry_month','bc_meses_cerrados')) AS last_sync_at,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(facturado) FROM v_se_facturacion
    WHERE empresa = $1 AND year = $2::int AND tipo IN ('P','R')), 0) AS planificacion_actual

INSERT INTO analytics_health_log
(company_name, year, check_name, bc_value, analytics_value, delta, status, details, alert_sent)
SELECT
  $1, $2::int, $3, NULLIF($4,'')::numeric, NULLIF($5,'')::numeric, NULLIF($6,'')::numeric,
  $7, COALESCE(NULLIF($8,'')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), ($9 = 'true')

SELECT company_name, check_name, bc_value, analytics_value, delta, status
FROM analytics_health_log
WHERE checked_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'
  AND status = 'fail'
ORDER BY company_name, check_name
